tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the ground of every inset field (search, inputs, textarea, reply form). Same value as `panel`: the neumorphic look depends on surfaces and page sharing one tone, separated only by shadow.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: sidebar, cards, post table, view box, modals, secondary buttons. Always paired with `shadow-sm` (or `shadow-md`) so it reads as raised.

tokens.name: panel-alt
tokens.usage: One step recessed: table row hover, notice rows, `.tag` fill, track-row dividers (1px), album-art placeholders, the open player row.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel` and `panel-alt` (9.5:1 light, 11.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta, dates, counts, table columns, inactive tabs and sort links. Contrast on `bg` is 3.05:1 in light (below 4.5:1 for small text; source value kept) and 4.64:1 in dark.

tokens.name: muted-2
tokens.usage: Tertiary marks only: empty stars, track numbers, IP tags, disabled options, scrollbar thumb. 1.9:1 light / 2.3:1 dark on `bg` — decorative, never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: music
tokens.usage: Brand blue. Start of `accent-gradient`, focus ring (2px outline, 2px offset), the blue bar of the app icon. As text on `bg`: 3.1:1 light / 4.45:1 dark (source value kept).

tokens.name: music-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `music`.

tokens.name: admin
tokens.usage: Danger and staff: admin badge, delete button, danger outline button, dislike, comment count in the list, report hover. White on it: 4.1:1 light, 2.8:1 dark (source kept; flag).

tokens.name: special
tokens.usage: Alias of `music`; kept because the source replaced a former purple with the UI blue. Use `music` in new work.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand violet. End of `accent-gradient`; underline colour on gradient-text links. As text on `bg`: 4.8:1 light, 3.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of `accent`.

tokens.name: sh-light
tokens.usage: Light (top-left) half of every neumorphic shadow. In the source it is a bare RGB triplet used inside rgba(); the shadow tokens carry it already resolved.

tokens.name: sh-dark
tokens.usage: Dark (bottom-right) half of every neumorphic shadow; also the header's soft drop shadow at 0.12 alpha.

tokens.name: panel-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky header fill, under `backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(10px)`.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: `.display` / `.brand`: the wordmark in the header. Capitals at 1.15em weight 900 in `accent-gradient`.

styles.name: board-title
styles.usage: Board name above the post table (`.board-title-row h1`).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base `body` text. Every style inherits letter-spacing -0.2px.

styles.name: list-title
styles.usage: Widget card title (2-line clamp) and recommended-song title (700).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, table cells, sidebar links — the most used size in the product. Tabs and primary buttons use 700.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sidebar group heads, table headers (600), track durations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, page buttons, sidebar links, logo badge, select options.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Comment items, review cards, textarea, dropdown panel, embedded video, album art in detail.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large containers: sidebar, post table, view box, widget cards, modals, album cover in grid.

shadow.note: Neumorphic pairs: a light shadow up-left and a dark one down-right. In the source each is written with var(--sh-light)/var(--sh-dark); here they are resolved per theme.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Default raised state for every `panel` surface and secondary button.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hover lift of cards, dropdown panel, album cover in detail.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Pressed (:active) buttons and the large post textarea.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-sm
tokens.usage: Input fields, search pill, and the selected state of tabs, sidebar links and page buttons.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Replaces `shadow-sm` on anything filled with `accent-gradient` (logo badge, write/submit buttons): a zero-offset blue + violet glow.

gradient.note: Theme-aware in components/bundle.css as linear-gradient(135deg, var(--music), var(--accent)).

tokens.name: accent-gradient
tokens.usage: Light-theme value. The brand gradient: primary buttons, logo badge, notice badge, selected option fill, and gradient TEXT (background-clip:text) for active/hover states. Dark theme runs #4B93FA to #8B5CF6.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Film-grain overlay on body::after (fractal-noise SVG, mix-blend-mode overlay). 0 in light; 0.05 in dark to dither shadow banding.
